name: Update Note
description: Updates a classic Salesforce note, which can contain up to 32 KB of text and is associated with a parent record. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_note.htm)

configurable_props.name: noteId
configurable_props.label: Note ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the note to update.

configurable_props.name: docsInfo
configurable_props.content: [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_note.htm) for more information on available fields.

configurable_props.name: Body
configurable_props.label: Body
configurable_props.description: Body of the note. Limited to 32 KB.

configurable_props.name: IsPrivate
configurable_props.label: Private
configurable_props.description: If true, only the note owner or a user with the “Modify All Data” permission can view the note or query it via the API.

configurable_props.name: OwnerId
configurable_props.label: Owner ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user who owns the note.

configurable_props.name: ParentId
configurable_props.label: Parent ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the object associated with the note. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_note.htm) for which objects can be referenced.

configurable_props.name: useAdvancedProps
configurable_props.label: See All Props
configurable_props.description: Set to true to see all available props for this object.
